description: Pre-registered follow-up to E019 (Muon lr 0.36 cost 1.04 pp on every seed). On the current tip (the 7.0-epoch Muon run if it is kept, else E018 at 7.5 epochs), change only the Muon lr for the conv filters from 0.24 to 0.16. The SGD lr for BN biases, whitening bias and head, the schedule shape, lookahead and NS3 all stay unchanged.
